links.outcome: Intra-model consistency (Fleiss kappa) of GPT-4o across repeated runs by input strategy
links.effect: Image-only kappa 0.25 (95% CI 0.07-0.43, fair); image-plus-text kappa 0.81 (95% CI 0.67-0.91, excellent).
links.quote: GPT-4o with image-strategy exhibited a fair consistency [0.25, 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.07-0.43], whereas the agreement of image-combined-text-strategy was excellent (0.81, 95% CI: 0.67-0.91).

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4o versus radiologists and a CNN on the same breast ultrasound cases
links.effect: GPT-4o image-only 58% vs image+text 70% (P=0.031); image+text similar to moderately experienced radiologists 71% (P=0.450) and CNN 74% (P=0.701).
links.quote: Diagnostic accuracy improved when deploying the image-combined-text-strategy compared to only image [58% (46 of 80) vs. 70% (56 of 80), P=0.031], which resembled board-certified moderately experienced radiologists (70% [56 of 80] vs. 71% [57 of 80], P=0.450) and customized CNN [70% (56 of 80) vs. 74% (59 of 80), P=0.701].

unlisted_practices: Combining images with original report text as input to a multimodal LLM to improve diagnostic accuracy

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter benchmark comparing GPT-4o (image vs image-plus-text input strategy) against CNNs and 95 radiologists for breast ultrasound mass classification. It evaluates model accuracy under different input prompts/strategies rather than an organizational deployment safeguard.
